## Programme and prices

Ecuador 2026: Living Nature

15 days/14 nights

Places visited: unique natural reserves from the Andes to the Amazon; diverse cloud forest; a journey into the Amazon.

The programme is valid for a minimum of 2 people in 2026.

Programme price per person in USD:

| 1–3 people | SGL | DBL | TPL |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mainland Ecuador + Galápagos Islands programme | 12775 | 7999 | 7443 |

*SGL price applies when 1 person is travelling.

**Single supplement (for 2 or more people): USD 1546
